latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the azure-global-search skill:

- Enables querying Microsoft Azure product information, documentation, parameters, features, and pricing from official sources without login.
- Designed for use cases such as product lookups, documentation search, specification comparison, and parameter identification.
- Includes bilingual support (English/Chinese) and comprehensive product alias mapping.
- Provides a structured catalog covering AI, Compute, Storage, Database, and more Azure service categories.
